arrangement.notes: Variation: experimental style with sparse verses and strong energetic hooks. Usage of sample-based layers including texture bed and one-shot hits. Channel names follow sample slicing techniques.

event_markers.label: Strong hook entry with sliced one-shot drum hits
event_markers.reason: Introduce energetic hook section with punchy drum samples sliced and triggered

event_markers.label: Sparse bass grooves
event_markers.reason: Reduce bass activity for sparse verse vibe

event_markers.label: Dark texture bed sample layer
event_markers.reason: Set moody atmosphere with textured sample layer

sound_intent.texture: dark, moody, atmospheric with light hiss and vinyl crackle
sound_intent.hits: sharp, snappy one-shot percussive elements for hooks
sound_intent.overall: sparse verses with dense hook contrast

routing_intent.drums: processed with transient shaper, routed to drum submix
routing_intent.vocal: dry in verses, doubled and processed in hooks

designer_intent.focus: experiment with dark phonk textures using sample-based layering and emphasizing sparse verses contrasting strong energetic hooks

presetor_intent.task: apply presets that enhance vintage sampler warmth and accentuate the sliced drum one-shots and texture beds without muddying mix clarity

sensei_drum.brief: Generate sliced drum hits for hooks and sparse, minimal percussion for verses using sample-based techniques.

bass_generator.brief: Create sparse basslines with space in verses and more pronounced bass in hooks complementing drums.

harmony_generator.brief: Provide subtle chord pads for atmosphere using sample-based textures with minimal movement.

melody_generator.brief: Add minimal melodic elements to provide hooks, relying on sample one-shots and minimal melodic phrasing.

ai_designer.brief: Coordinate arrangement with experimental dark phonk style focusing on energy contrast between sparse verses and strong hooks.

presetor.brief: Select and apply effects presets that contribute to a vintage yet clear phonk aesthetic emphasizing sample texture and hit articulation.

songgps.brief: Monitor and guide energy curve and section transitions ensuring sparse verses contrast with energetic hooks, respecting production intents.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Balance levels and spatial placement maintaining clarity between texture bed and one-shot layers with emphasis on dynamic hooks.
